item_short_desc: Griffin’s Heel & Sole Renew is built for uniformed professionals who need their duty boots and dress shoes looking sharp and inspection-ready. Designed to restore worn edges, heels, and soles, the deep black pigmentation renews color and finish with ease. The precision sponge applicator ensures even coverage in hard-to-reach areas, perfect for tactical boots, oxfords, uniform shoes, and everyday footwear. Proudly crafted in the United States for superior quality and durability.
